description: No product kit declared: user-guide-writer asks nothing about it, drafts and saves the page, and its report says that no product kit is declared.
prompt: use user-guide-writer for `portal/reports/monthly-digest/`. Skip questions and draft with your best guess, then save the page. Facts: the user selects **Звіти** in the menu, selects a month in the **Місяць** field and clicks **Завантажити**. The monthly statement of account movements downloads as a PDF: one row per credit or debit, with the date, amount, currency and the balance after it. The statement for a month is ready on the first day of the next month.

assertions.name: says no product kit is declared
assertions.pattern: \bno product kit\b|\b(doesn't|does not|didn't|did not) declare (a|any) product kit\b|\bproduct kit\b[^.\n]{0,40}\b(not declared|undeclared|isn't declared|wasn't declared|none)\b|немає набору продукту|без набору продукту|набір продукту[^.\n]{0,40}не (оголошено|задекларовано|вказано)
